INTRODUCING BLEE

Get all content reviewed, approved, and tracked.

All in one platform.

From pre-reading content before it’s published, to always-on monitoring of digital channels, Blee makes sure all your content is aligned with the rules and guidelines that matter to you.

All rules

Regulatory frameworks. Brand guidelines. Custom rules and preferences. Blee applies it.

All content

10,000-word blogs. Hour-long videos.

Figma mockups. Blee's AI pre-reads it.

All channels

Social media. Partner sites. Affiliate marketing. Blee covers it.

All the time

Automatic routing. Always-on monitoring. Contextual AI reviews. Blee’s on it.

Built to handle your volume of content. Before publishing. And after.


content reviews

Quickly review and approve content before it goes live

Blee’s context-aware AI pre-reads all content for you, flagging the issues that marketing can fix before you take a look—and highlighting where you need to focus your attention.



Easy-to-use dashboard

Shows everything that needs your attention, across all channels.



Robust system of record

Every draft and decision is logged automatically so you're always audit-ready.



Embedded in marketing tools

See compliance feedback where teams actually create so they can understand and fix straightforward issues immediately.

Learn more

content monitoring

Find and fix content after it’s been published

Blee's AI continuously checks your website, product pages, social channels, and partner content, surfacing what's new or changed. Keeping you on top of all content, wherever and whenever it's published.



Shadow content detection

Finds published content that bypassed formal review channels entirely.



Continuous scanning

Proactively catches what has changed on your website and partner sites after approval.



Social and influencer monitoring

Keeps tabs on multiple creators and fast-moving channels for you, 24/7.

Learn more

Content compliance that everyone can trust

Designed for the teams that review content, create content, and keep other teams moving along.

What makes Blee different



Context aware

Blee handles your documentation, audits, and regulations with rigor while recognizing the difference between real risk and creative marketing.



Workflows work

Blee pre-reads and flags issues, routes work, manages permissions, and shares workloads so projects and campaigns keep moving.



Shared understanding

Blee explains the why behind every flag, so marketing and legal work from the same understanding. The straightforward fixes happen without the back-and-forth.

AI-FIRST MARKETING COMPLIANCE

Your rules.

Your content.

Your AI.

Our legal engineers work with your team to build rules based on industry regulations, internal guidelines, and your organization’s level of risk tolerance. Which are then fine-tuned with your feedback.

‍

For deeply contextual, enterprise-grade accuracy that makes sure nothing slips through the cracks.
